title: FrameMenuCard
description: frame.menu-card@1: one card a site publishes for the network's Frame menu. Each open site serves an array of at most three cards at /.well-known/openvibe-menu.json (frame.menu-cards@1); Network fetches that public file every five minutes, validates every card here, strips markup from the text and ranks the cards in GET /api/frame. A card is one kind of menu block: a rail (the live rail), rows (a ranked list) or chips (a short row of words). Every item links to https on the site's own origin or an openvibe.* host; Network refuses another origin. An item may also carry a small picture (image) of the same shape: https on the site's own origin or an openvibe.* host, with an optional 16–1920 pixel width and height and a short alt text. The text is plain words: markup is stripped, unknown fields are dropped and a file that fails this schema leaves the site's last good card in place for 30 minutes.

id.description: The card's stable id in its site (live-now, new-worlds, trending). Two cards of one site never share it.

site.description: The Frame site id that publishes the card (live, games, media-hub). Network checks it against the host the file came from.

title.description: The card's heading, in the owner's words.

kind.description: The block the Frame draws: a rail of live channels, a ranked list of rows, or a short row of chips.

items.description: The card's entries, in the site's own order. Empty means the site has a card but nothing to show (nobody is live); Network then skips it.

meta.description: One short line under the name: "12 watching", "7,412 views this week", "3 players".

url.description: Where the entry opens: https on the publishing site's own origin or an openvibe.* host.

image.description: A small picture of the entry: a video's thumbnail, a world's cover or a stream's preview. Optional; a site with no real picture leaves it out rather than sending a placeholder.

src.description: The picture's address: https on the publishing site's own origin or an openvibe.* host. Network drops an image from another host.

w.description: The picture's natural width in pixels, when the site knows it.

h.description: The picture's natural height in pixels, when the site knows it.

alt.description: A short description of the picture for anyone who cannot see it. May be empty when the entry's title already says it.

url.description: https on the publishing site's own origin or an openvibe.* host.

updated_at.description: When the site last built the card.

ttl_s.description: How long the site considers the card fresh, in seconds. Live uses 30; Network itself refetches every five minutes.
